description: Find hotels and villas MAPL Tours drives to from Sangster International Airport (MBJ), Montego Bay, Jamaica. Returns up to 8 matches with the id to use in get_transfer_quote, or the "Other hotel or villa" id for each area when nothing matches. Covers 199 properties from Montego Bay to Negril, Ocho Rios, Falmouth and Lucea. Kingston, Port Antonio and Mandeville are quoted by email instead.
